content: .{@-याम@} {%a.%} not old or weakened, not stale, fresh, not worn out by use; अयातयामं सर्वेभ्यो भागेभ्यो भागमुत्तमम् <ls>Mb. 3. 114. 11</ls>. ˚मं च यौवनम् <ls>Dk. 123</ls> fresh, blooming; ˚मं वयः <ls n="Dk.">158</ls>; छन्दांस्ययातयामानि <ls>Bhāg. 10. 80. 42</ls>. (where Śrīdhara says अ˚ = विगतदोषाणि free from faults, faultless, pure.) . ({@-मम्@}) <ab>N.</ab> of certain texts of the Yajurveda revealed to YājYavalkya. -˚यामता freshness, unimpaired nature, strength, or vigour, purity. .--{@<ab>Comp.</ab>@}
